qa: This effect prevents [When Digivolving] effects on cards from activating. [When Digivolving] effects can no longer activate by triggering or when effects such as "activate that card's [When Digivolving]" effect" activate.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: [Security] At the end of the battle, play this card without paying the cost. [On Play] [When Digivolving] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP for the turn.

text_sections.label: Link Condition
text_sections.text: ＜Link＞ [Appmon] trait: Cost 2 (Plug this card from the hand or battle area sideways into the specified Digimon in the battle area.)

text_sections.label: Link Effect
text_sections.text: [When Linking] Until your opponent's turn ends, 1 of their Digimon can't activate [When Digivolving] effects.
